name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a junior gold exploration company focused on acquiring mineral properties and royalty interests in Nevada's Walker Lane trend. The company holds a 50% earn-in interest in the Lapon Canyon Gold Project, where an active 2026 reverse circulation drill program is targeting resource expansion and deeper intrusive-related gold mineralization. Nevada Canyon operates an asset-light royalty and earn-in model to limit capital intensity while capturing exploration upside.
